firmware.title: Irisha (eCat)
firmware.author: Mikhail Matveev, Mikhail Revzin
firmware.description: The Irisha school computer, with the Dialog and Kaspiy, and their floppy drives. Emulated by eCat3; ROMs are built in.
firmware.controls: USB keyboard. F11: file browser, F12: settings; a key at power-on picks the model.
